_comment: Generic template. The agent chooses the actual direction during the Discovery Flow and rewrites domain + probes to fit it. Probe KINDS stay the same; only their names/greps change to match the chosen phenomenon. Always keep at least one off-objective probe.

probes.name: offobj
probes.note: a capability the objective does NOT reward — where emergence hides

probes.name: internal
probes.note: a structural measure (sparsity, circuit presence, rank)

probes.name: fit
probes.note: train fit — distinguishes 'learned nothing' from 'learned, no transfer'

domain: CHOSEN BY THE AGENT during Discovery Flow — no fixed direction
